title: Autonomous biomedical research with an artificial intelligence agent.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Downloaded biomni_eval1_dataset.parquet (112 KB, Apache-2.0, not gated) from Hugging Face: 433 rows, 6 columns (instance_id, task_instance_id, prompt, task_name, split, answer); all rows split='val'; 10 tasks with 10-50 rows each (e.g. 50 gwas_causal_gene_opentargets, 30 rare_disease_diagnosis, 10 crispr_delivery).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Paper is paywalled, no PMCID, no full text or supplement in Europe PMC; only the abstract was read. No other data deposit found by paper_context (no GEO/SRA/Zenodo/Dryad hits).

a1_downloadable.note: Benchmark parquet downloads openly from Hugging Face (checked file).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: An 'answer' column exists, but it is a free-text answer (gene symbol, rsID, letter) to a natural-language prompt, an agent benchmark rather than a supervised measurement (checked file).

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs are text prompts listing candidate genes/variants; solving them needs external databases, so features are not really present.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable: categorical answers, no physical units.

a5_enough_rows.note: 433 rows total across 10 heterogeneous tasks, 10-50 per task; far below the 400-per-classification-task / 1,500-row threshold (checked file).

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not compare: paper full text not accessible; HF card size tag says 1K<n<10K but file has 433 rows.

a8_label_provenance.note: Answers derive from curated sources (Open Targets, GWAS Catalog, LAB-Bench), per task names; not model outputs, as far as visible.

honest_claim_h3: None: the paper is an AI-agent system paper whose only released data is a 433-question agent benchmark, not a labelled dataset for training a model.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use benchmark question text to predict the correct answer gene or variant for biomedical research questions.
plain_idea.train_on: Text prompts listing candidate genes or genetic variants plus a phenotype; 433 questions in total (verified), split over 10 task types.
plain_idea.predict: The single correct gene, variant or option, taken from curated sources such as Open Targets and the GWAS Catalog.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little: it is an evaluation set for AI agents, too small and heterogeneous to train a model, and the underlying sources are better used directly.

ml_idea: None viable; the released data is a small agent-evaluation question set. Only use would be evaluating an agent, which is outside this tool's scope.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Row count of biomni_eval1_dataset.parquet: 433 rows over 10 tasks (done; kills it).

verdict_reason: AI-agent methods paper; the only open data is Biomni-Eval1, 433 benchmark questions across 10 tasks (10-50 each), an evaluation set too small and heterogeneous for supervised ML (A5 fails).
